instruction: Breadth pass, only for an eligible work goal or truly blank browsing: build the useful candidate set before writing the rank fields. Keep the strongest three direct matches first, then use ranks 4 through 8 for practical methods that help complete the same work. Review the whole remaining catalog for preparing inputs, drafting or rehearsing, checking quality, packaging or sharing the result, and tracking follow-up. A video can teach a useful supporting operation even when its example uses another department, audience or tool; judge whether that operation transfers to this goal rather than requiring the same nouns. Another demonstration of the same task is useful when it teaches a different method. Before setting rank4, rank5 or rank6 to null, check all unused candidates for those concrete connections; do not stop merely because the closest title matches are exhausted. Prefer six to eight useful distinct videos, retaining the direct matches ahead of supporting steps. If no further candidate has a concrete useful connection, leave the remaining ranks null. Never fill a slot with generic or unrelated content just to reach a count. This breadth pass never makes an instruction-only goal eligible and never permits a repeated position.
